etymology.historical_story: If the token refers to Mr. Krabs, its relevant background is animation rather than Malay word formation. Nickelodeon identifies Eugene Harold Krabs as the owner of the Krusty Krab. His name can occur unchanged in Malay discussion, but that possibility does not establish the supplied lowercase token as a Malay dictionary word. [Nickelodeon: Mr. Krabs](https://www.nick.com/info-page/0vq4xx/mr-krabs).
